purpose: Close inherited documentation drift around the Founder Capital Decision evidence-authority surface and record the focused current-main sandbox and ATTACK-20 source repairs without converting repository edits into provider, runtime, security, financing, merge, deploy, publication, or outcome proof.

claims: src/http/routes/founderCapitalDecision.ts must keep the capital decision route founder-authenticated, evidence-bound, and non-authorizing: a returned decision card cannot itself grant financing, spend, investor-contact, merge, deploy, publication, or execution authority, and stale or insufficient evidence must fail closed rather than preserve derived certainty.

public/control-room/capital-decision.js must present the Capital Decision surface as an evidence evaluation view with an explicit authority ceiling; it cannot imply that a recommendation, score, option set, or HOLD state grants financing, spend, investor-contact, merge, deploy, publication, or execution authority.

e2e/founder-capital-decision-proof.mjs must verify that missing or stale evidence removes derived certainty, that the focused preview may remain HOLD when broader evidence is absent, and that the browser continues to state that no financing authority is granted.

labs/ai-company/cloudflare-sandbox/wrangler.jsonc must remain valid JSON for the dormant sandbox contract, declare exactly one InternalSandbox container and one Sandbox durable-object binding, keep workers_dev false with no public routes, and must not be interpreted as production execution authority merely because the source contract parses.

security/portfolio-worker-security.json must bind declaredFromMainSha to the exact reviewed base used for source verification while preserving overallState and unobserved provider/runtime fields as UNVERIFIED or unknown until independently observed; refreshing source identity cannot manufacture production security proof.
